notes: CR 510.2, 603.2c, Sporeweb Weaver ruling 2020-06-23: the Weaver attacks and is blocked by a 2/2 and a 1/1. All combat damage of the step (the blockers' 2 and 1 to the Weaver, the Weaver's 1 to the Bear) is dealt simultaneously as one event, so 'whenever this creature is dealt damage' triggers ONCE: one Saproling and 1 life. Before the fix it triggered once per blocker (2 Saprolings, 22 life). The first-strike twin is sporeweb_weaver_first_strike_and_regular_trigger_twice.json.
